verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server under its own GitHub org. The server exposes web, local, image, video and news search, LLM context and summarization tools, and Brave's own guides cover connecting it to Claude Desktop and Claude Cowork on Bedrock. The probe confirms the server repo is documented; the community ToS discussion concerns plan licensing, not whether the MCP server works. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server.
